findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#h-chevron" for y between 53.06s and 53.36s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: GSAP tween uses `repeat: -1` (infinite), but the composition declares a finite 53.197s window. HyperFrames clips deterministic seeking and export to that explicit duration.
findings.fixHint: Keep the explicit finite composition `data-duration`. Use a finite repeat count only when the loop itself must end before the composition does.
